notes.title: First Release
notes.notes:
I'm very excited about the release of the first game.

There are still a lot of deficiencies as we have produced it within a set period of time.

But I made it with affection, so I think it would be good to enjoy it lightly!

Our game will be released on December 10th.

I will update you steadily in the future and show you a better appearance. 

Thank you.
